FINITE_STATE_MODEL.insight: the full history of admissible `last` values is unnecessary. Only the DISTANCE matters, and it saturates.
FINITE_STATE_MODEL.state: set of admissible ages-since-last-accepted-fire, domain {0,1,2,3,4,5,OLD} where OLD means last <= i-6

transitions.raw FALSE: output FALSE for every admissible state; ages advance; uncertainty persists
transitions.raw TRUE: per state: age<6 -> reject (FALSE, age carries); age OLD -> accept (TRUE, age:=0). Output VALID only if all admissible states agree.
transitions.raw UNKNOWN: BOTH TRUE and FALSE branches propagated — never coerced to FALSE

BRUTE_FORCE_EQUIVALENCE.method: enumerate every admissible prior history (2^8) and every completion of unknown raws, run the canonical indicators.apply_cooldown, collect the output set per position, compare to the finite-state model
BRUTE_FORCE_EQUIVALENCE.VERDICT: EXACT — the finite state reproduces the admissible-set semantics

CORRECTION_COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD.my_claim: n-1 = 5 proven-FALSE bars are sufficient for the next TRUE to be deterministically accepted
CORRECTION_COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD.status: WRONG — off by one in the PERMISSIVE direction
CORRECTION_COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD.trace: unknown start {0..5,OLD}; after 5 FALSE the youngest admissible age is 5, still < 6, so a TRUE disagrees (reject vs accept)
CORRECTION_COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD.consequence_if_uncaught: rows whose cooldown state was genuinely ambiguous would have been emitted as AVAILABLE_VALID

GAP_LENGTH_COLLAPSE.finding: the canonical apply_cooldown advances its index over EVERY bar including contaminated ones (raw is False there), so an observed gap of length g contributes g to the distance
GAP_LENGTH_COLLAPSE.rule: gap length >= 6 collapses the incoming state to {OLD} by itself; gap length < 6 leaves ambiguity
GAP_LENGTH_COLLAPSE.significance: for 83.9% of interior gaps a pre-gap fire can still be cooling when the segment resumes

RETROACTIVE_FINDING.affected: Stage A (bcf90cbdd8e4b7dd) computed PRE_PUMP via compute_wlnbb PER SEGMENT, which restarts cooldown with last = -(n+1) = OLD
RETROACTIVE_FINDING.problem: that is the OPTIMISTIC assumption and is not licensed for the 83.9% of gaps shorter than 6 bars
RETROACTIVE_FINDING.blast_radius: PRE_PUMP enters only the l_sig named-fallback path. The full-store census found 47 such rows, of which 21 were VALID. So the practical exposure is at most 21 rows out of 5,846,516.
RETROACTIVE_FINDING.status: RECORDED, NOT SILENTLY IGNORED — bounded and negligible for support, but it is a correctness deviation and must not be discovered later as a surprise
RETROACTIVE_FINDING.same_issue_applies_to: any per-segment restart of a cooldown-bearing feature

cooldown_layer.raw FALSE with raw VALID: output VALID FALSE even if cooldown state unknown
cooldown_layer.raw TRUE with raw VALID: AVAILABLE_VALID only if every admissible cooldown state agrees; else INITIALIZATION_SENSITIVE

SIG_BUY_AVAILABILITY_CONTRACT.principle: unknown state does NOT make every row unknown — on non-fire bars the output is trivially identifiable. Same structure as the corrected g* rule.
